title: Your Significance and Purpose Within the Body of Christ
titleZh: 你在基督身體裡的重要性與目的
summaryZh: 彼此分享日常領受，能鼓勵他人並加深肢體連結。
lines: So, my father was literally dying, but his sense of humor didn't disappear.
我父親當時真的快要離世了，但他的幽默感並沒有消失。
So it was still with him.
所以他仍然保有幽默感。
But we come together to contribute to the life of another.
但我們聚在一起，是為了豐富別人的生命。
And it may not be some profound revelation.
這可能不是什麼深刻的啟示。
It doesn't have to be like this.
It should just be a word of encouragement.
它可以只是一句鼓勵的話。
It's the fact that you woke up to this song.
就是你一醒來，腦中便有這首歌。
一醒來就聽見；醒來時注意到
And the words of this song may be for someone in this room.
這首歌的歌詞，或許是為了這個房間裡的某個人。
And you say, "Hey, John, when I woke up this morning, this song was playing in my head," and you share it.
你就說：「嘿，約翰，我今天早上醒來時，腦中一直播放著這首歌。」然後把它分享出來。
And often what you've experienced brings a word of encouragement to the person who needs it.
你所經歷的事，常常會成為一句鼓勵，帶給需要的人。
This strengthens the connection between the body's members.
這會加強基督身體各肢體之間的連結。
This is who we are by design.
這就是神設計我們成為的樣子。
None of us knows ourselves completely on our own.
我們沒有任何人能單靠自己完全認識自己。
We are not designed that way.
我們受造並不是這個樣子。
We are created to know our identity, our purpose, our place, all through our connection to the family He has brought us into.
我們受造，是要透過與祂帶我們進入的家連結，認識自己的身分、目的和位置。
This is the privilege of life.
這就是生命中的一份恩典。
I was in Vacaville yesterday for a one-day conference there at the mission.
昨天我在瓦卡維爾的宣教中心參加一場為期一天的特會。
And a woman came up and just expressed her gratitude for Bethel TV because she can connect with us.
有位女士走上前來，向伯特利電視台表達感謝，因為她能藉此與我們連結。
Due to her health, she cannot be here.
由於健康因素，她無法來到這裡。
So I understand that there are so many people for whom the only way to stay connected is online, through YouTube or some other service.
所以我明白，對許多人來說，透過 YouTube 或其他服務上網，是他們保持連結的唯一方式。
I understand that and welcome it.
我明白這一點，也歡迎這樣的方式。
But there is a challenge for you and me.
但你我都面臨一個挑戰。
And this is what happened to us.
We focused on dedicating ourselves to missions to touch the peoples of the world.
我們專注於委身宣教，去觸及世界各地的民族。
We thought that even the devil didn't know where we were, so we could ambush him at a bend in the road.
我們想，連魔鬼都不知道我們在哪裡，所以我們可以在路彎處伏擊牠。
So we were just talking about our responsibility to the nations, literally.
所以我們當時談的，真的是我們對列國的責任。
It took a few years before it became popular, but eventually it did.
過了幾年，這件事才逐漸普及，但最後確實普及了。
And I think in the last year of my time there, we sent almost 150 people to different parts of the world to preach the Gospel.
我想，在我待在那裡的最後一年，我們派了將近一百五十人到世界各地傳福音。
They stayed there for anywhere from a week to a whole year.
他們在那裡待的時間，從一週到整整一年不等。
But this was our main priority.
但這是我們最優先的事。
In those years, before the fall of the Iron Curtain, we made several trips behind it.
在那些年，也就是鐵幕倒下之前，我們曾多次到鐵幕後方。
Our people went mainly to Romania to serve there.
我們的人主要去羅馬尼亞服事。
Believers and our people equipped special cars with secret compartments, transported Bibles, medicines, and more, playing a kind of "James Bond" when they entered the country.
當地信徒和我們的人把特殊車輛裝上暗格，運送聖經、藥品等物資；他們進入那個國家時，就像在演一場「詹姆士龐德」。
But our teams were deeply moved by the passion, the thirst, and the willingness of these people they served to take a bullet for the Gospel.
但我們的團隊深受感動，看見他們服事的這些人對福音充滿熱忱、渴慕，甚至願意為福音中槍。
This became a true testimony that left a mark on our people.
這成了真實的見證，在我們的人心中留下深刻印記。
They would come home with these stories, and we were simply overwhelmed by the news about our brothers and sisters in that part of the world.
他們帶著這些故事回家，而我們聽見世界那一端弟兄姊妹的消息，心裡簡直深受震撼。
I remember I was in Redding at the former Hilton Hotel.
我記得那時我在雷丁，地點是以前的希爾頓飯店。
Some of you, if you've been around long enough, know that it has a different name now.
你們當中有些人若在這裡待得夠久，就知道它現在改了名字。
We held a retreat for men on the very night the Iron Curtain fell.
鐵幕倒下的那個晚上，我們正好舉辦了一場男性退修會。
I remember turning on the TV in my room before the meeting and seeing people walking through that fallen wall in Berlin.
我記得聚會前，我在房間打開電視，看見人們走過柏林那道倒下的牆。
And they were singing, "This is the day."
他們正在唱：「這是耶和華所定的日子。」
"This is the day that the Lord has made."
Later I learned that it was at the very spot where the wall fell that people passed from East Berlin to West Berlin.
後來我才知道，人們正是在柏林圍牆倒下的那個地點，從東柏林走到西柏林。
